% ak_bind_masked.tex — \problem{}-style key against ak_bind.json where
% problem 2 boxes a wrong value (26) while the correct 4.51 survives in the
% worked step beside it. The old checker matched verified values against the
% whole segment, so the step masked the wrong box (audit B2). Must FAIL and
% name problem 2 — run_tests.sh greps for it.
\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\newcounter{prob}
\newcommand{\problem}[1]{\stepcounter{prob}\par\textbf{\theprob.}\quad #1\par}
\begin{document}

\section*{Answer Key}

\problem{Solve $2x - 14 = 0$.}
\textbf{Solution:} $2x = 14$, so $x = 7$. $\boxed{7}$

\problem{Compute $9.02 / 2$.}
\textbf{Solution:} $9.02 / 2 = 4.51$. Final: $\boxed{26}$

\problem{Solve $3x - 15 = 0$.}
\textbf{Solution:} $3x = 15$, so $x = 5$. $\boxed{5}$

\end{document}
